settings.title: Settings
settings.editingProject: Editing this project’s config, which overrides yours:
settings.copyToProject: Make a copy for this project
settings.mobile: Settings need the terminal, desktop or VS Code.

config.offer: Create docket's config at {path}, with every setting at its default? You can edit it there, or with ⚙.
config.lookAt: Look at your new config: {path}. Every setting is there at its default.
config.updated: docket updated its config at {path} from version {from} to {to}.
config.updatedAdding: docket updated its config at {path} from version {from} to {to}, adding {added} at their defaults.
config.unreadable: docket couldn't read its config at {path}, so it's using the defaults until the file is fixed.

language: Language of the docket's own words: auto follows Claude Code's language setting
display: A pane beside the transcript, or a band above the prompt
emoji: Master switch for every emoji the docket draws
headingEmoji: An emoji before each list's heading
noItemEmojiLists: Letters of lists whose items draw no emoji, e.g. "Q,P"
inlineLists: Letters of lists drawn on one line, separated by dots
targetWords: Soft word limits per list, e.g. "P=8,Q=30"
itemColor: Color of an item changed this turn, a hex or a theme key
itemDimColor: Color of an item unchanged since the last turn
upArrowColor: Color of the ↑ when a list grew this turn
upNumberColor: Color of the count beside a growing list's ↑
downArrowColor: Color of the ↓ when a list shrank this turn
downNumberColor: Color of the count beside a shrinking list's ↓
leanColor: Color of the lean line, a hex or a theme key; empty for the item's own color
leanDimColor: Color of the lean line while its item is dimmed as unchanged
answeredLingerSeconds: Seconds an item answered by button stays up, dimmed, before it goes
strikeLingerMinutes: Minutes an item Claude closed on its own stays up struck through
